context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useUpdateItem mutation hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs for updating cart item quantities. It focuses on proper hook initialization with a wait/debounce context, correct argument passing, and usage of the debounce feature.

checklist.name: useUpdateItem hook usage
checklist.description: The useUpdateItem hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and properly initialized

checklist.name: Wait context parameter
checklist.description: The hook is called with a context object containing a wait property to configure the debounce delay

checklist.name: Update arguments
checklist.description: The mutation is called with an object containing quantity, id (itemId), productId, and variantId as required by the hook

checklist.name: Debounce behavior
checklist.description: The quantity update mutation is not called immediately on every input change event; a debounce or timeout mechanism is used

checklist.name: Initial quantity display
checklist.description: The input element is initialized with the currentQuantity prop value from the component's props
